Each strain carries its own k-mers, rebuilt from its own alleles around every site. Checked on 22 long-read assemblies of strains the panel takes from another source: 15 ranked first, 21 first or within the reported tie set; the miss is a DBVPG6044 stock disagreement between ScRAPdb and the 1011 matrix (db/README.md).

Inside the S288C family strains differ at a few to a few dozen panel sites, as much as two stocks of one strain drift apart. The SNP panel names the family; mating type and native markers name the strain, and the report lists every strain neither can exclude.
k must stay well below the read length. The SRR26617475 run has 35 bp reads, where k=31 called 14 sites out of 35263 and k=21 called 34003 of 36694.
